overview.heading: Build Domain AI Apps Without Boilerplate
overview.description: CORTEX provides a ready-to-use Go + Next.js + SQLite single-binary foundation with GitHub Copilot native LLM routing, streaming chat, autonomous task graphs, self-scheduling timers, and schema-free JSON collections.

cards.copilotDesc: OAuth Device Flow, automatic session token exchange, /chat/completions, /responses, /v1/messages, failover, and cost tracking.
cards.chatDesc: Multi-turn sessions, agent profile switching, real-time SSE for thinking & tool execution, and file attachments.
cards.tasksDesc: Decompose high-level goals into parallel subagent graphs and produce structured domain artifacts.
cards.timersDesc: Recurring Cron/interval schedules, one-shot run_at timestamps, and agent self-scheduling.
cards.collectionsDesc: Read and write arbitrary JSON documents via /api/collections/{name} from both Next.js and AI agents.
cards.i18nDesc: Switch UI language anytime and automatically synchronize the AI agent's thinking and output language.
